notes.title: Learning to Bear – Patch Notes v1.31
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.31


 Fixed an issue where minimap hints were being added multiple times.
 Any duplicates will now be automatically removed when the next hint is collected.



 Optional quests are now removed after leaving a mission to keep the quest log clean.



 Quest remove feature: you can now permanently delete quests using the X button in the quest log — helpful for players with outdated or broken quests.



 The Moving Climb mission now correctly has a follow-up quest.



 Added notifications for unnspent talent points and new abilities granted during missions



Thanks for playing!

 if you encounter any issues please let me know! 🐻
